A type of ''' passenger starliner''' was active during the [[New Republic Era]]. Multiple [[Passenger liner|starliners]] were present on the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]]. During [[Daimyo]] [[Boba Fett]]'s activities on Tatooine, one starliner's passengers included members of the [[Pyke Syndicate]].<ref name="Chapter 3" /> The [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]], [[Din Djarin]] traveled aboard the starline on a non-stop flight from [[Glavis Ringworld]] to [[Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Chapter 5" />
